On the translucent `bg-card/30` dark surface the carousel story + every dark consumer places the rail on, the inactive dot resolves ~1.2:1 contrast — below the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text floor, functionally invisible. The row read as one lopsided bright bar with no track.

W2_deadScaleClass.finding: the active dot's emphasis rode `scale-[var(--scale-hover)]`. `--scale-hover` exists (tokens.css:1075 = 1.08) but the var-in-arbitrary form `scale-[var(--…)]` is silently dropped by Tailwind v4's content-scan — NO stylesheet rule emits, so the live computed transform was `none`. The only real active emphasis was the `w-6` width, which alone reads as a 'progress fill' not a position pip.

carouselDotsReauthor.mechanism: re-authored from first principles against the slides DeckPager oracle. The dot is painted in a scoped `::before` inside a 24x24 transparent hit target (WCAG 2.5.8). The inactive fill is `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 52%, transparent)` — the house surface-tint pattern at the 52% stop the token ladder does not pre-mint (the ladder tops at 40%, which clears >=3:1 in DARK but not LIGHT). The active emphasis is a REAL emitted scoped rule `.carousel-dot[data-active]::before { width|height: var(--dot-elongated); background: var(--foreground) }` — the dot elongates into a pip + lifts to full foreground; the dead `scale-[var(--scale-hover)]` arbitrary class is EXCISED. The morph rides the governed --spring-dock register; the button composes .tap-squish (press-spring) + .focus-ring (the token-first focus cue). a11y (role=tablist/tab, aria-selected, aria-label) preserved.

rungDecision.ratified: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 52%, transparent) — the DeckPager oracle value, inlined in the scoped CSS (NOT a new token in tokens.css)
rungDecision.rationale: the audit candidate --surface-tint-25 resolves 2.03:1 (dark) / 1.71:1 (light) — BELOW the 3:1 floor on the composited bg-card/30 dark card. The ladder's highest sub-loud rung, 40%, resolves 3.32:1 (dark) / 2.50:1 (light) — still fails LIGHT. The lowest stop that clears >=3:1 in BOTH schemes is 52% (the DeckPager-proven value). Since no existing --surface-tint-* rung clears the floor and tokens.css is OUT of bounds (W23 consumes, does not mint), the in-bounds gestalt fix is the SAME house pattern (color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) N%, transparent)) at the 52% stop, inlined at the use-site in the SFC's scoped CSS — exactly the DeckPager oracle shape.

measuredContrast.method: WCAG 1.4.11 contrast of the resolved inactive-dot color (foreground 52% over the composited bg-card/30 dark surface) vs that surface, computed from the EMITTED dist/glass-ui.css recipe
